newsitem.title: USA: USDA to hold workshop on meat price reporting.
newsitem.headline: USDA to hold workshop on meat price reporting.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Monday it would hold a workshop on retail meat price reporting and farm-to-retail price spreads on Dec. 18 in Kansas City.

"We are inviting representatives of producers, the livestock marketing industry, the retail sector, and universities to review USDA's current retail meat price series and price spread information and suggest improvements," Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said in a statement.
The session, which will be sponsored by USDA's Economic Research Service, is part of an ongoing effort by the department to increase information in the livestock markets.
